# Summary and conclusion

真正的长期价值是把中性原子模拟器变成一种“universality-class spectrometer”：理论上可应用于 Potts、Ashkin–Teller、chiral transitions，甚至不知道低能场论是什么的系统。

针对CFT在实验的演示，此前已经有很多重要成果，所以不能把本文概括成“首次观察 CFT”或“首次研究临界激发”。

- [Keesling 等的 Rydberg KZ 实验](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-019-1070-1)、
- [Fang 等的临界态与边界普适性实验](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.15376)、
- [Joshi 等的纠缠 Hamiltonian 实验](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-023-06768-0)，
- [CoNb\(_2\)O\(_6\) 中的 \(E_8\) 质量谱](https://arxiv.org/abs/1103.3694)。


# A adiabatic process for CFT

Consider the 1D hard-core Boson Hamiltonian with length $L$:
$$
\begin{align}
\hat H=\sum_i
\left[\frac{\Omega}{2} P_{i-1}X_iP_{i+1}
-\Delta n_i\right]
+\sum_{j-i\geq 2}V_{ij}n_in_j.
\end{align}
$$
This hamiltonian are known to satisfied the following properties:

- There exists a $\Delta_c$ such that the ground state gap satisfied $\Delta_{\mathrm{gap}}(L,\Delta_c)\sim L^{-1}$
- Denoting the spectrum at $\Delta_c$ as $E_n(L,\Delta_c)$, then it satisfies
$$
\lim_{L\to\infty} \frac{L}{\pi\hbar v} \bigl[E_n(L,\Delta_c)-E_0(L,\Delta_c)\bigr] = x_n.
$$


Then we can design a protocol to "see" this spectrum.
Change $\Delta$ by a time-dependent detuning $\delta\Delta_i(t):=A\cos(2\pi ft+\phi)e^{-t^2/w^2}$, we get a pertubation Hamitonian
$$
\delta\hat H_{\mathrm{global}}(t) =A\cos(2\pi ft+\phi)e^{-t^2/w^2}\left(\sum_i\hat n_i \right).
$$
This brings up a transition probability
$$
\begin{align}
c_e\propto A\langle e|\hat K|g\rangle \int_{0}^{T} dt\,e^{-t^2/w^2} \cos(2\pi ft+\phi) e^{i(E_e-E_g)t/\hbar},
\end{align}
$$
which will peak at point $f = |E_e - E_g|$. 
This means that sweep $f$ would give the information of the spectrum information of the Hamiltonian.
